units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:4:8">Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שבטא דכדכד ביניהן</he> (Bab. ed. <he>דכדכדא</he>, corr. acc.) the staff of the shuttle (the cane which brings the threads of the web into their place [arundo]), is between them, i.e. there is a great difference between them (cmp. ‘stamen secernit arundo’, Ovid M. 6, 55).
